messages:
mike_support: Escalating OraHealth onboarding to CS — provisioning failing repeatedly, customer is blocked and renewal touches in 3 weeks. Account ID acct_4234, ARR ~288k, high-value. We hit 4 failed ingest jobs and a 403 on token refresh. Need priority handling and a comms plan.

mike_support: Quick context: started onboarding 2026-03-10, ingestion pipeline errors on customer side + our 401/403 spikes. They reported 50% of API calls failing.

anna_cs: On it. Can someone drop the error logs and the support runbook link? I'll coordinate a bridge with the customer.

mike_support: Paste of the most common error snippet:
```
2026-03-22T15:03:12Z ERROR ingest: request failed id=acct_4234 code=403 reason="token refresh failed: invalid_grant"
2026-03-22T15:03:12Z WARN retrying (1/3)
```
Also seeing quota exceeded on embedding jobs: "quota_exceeded: daily_requests" for org acct_4234.

triage-bot: [incident] Created P1 case #INC-2026-178 for acct_4234 — assigned to customer-success. SLA: 2 business hours for initial outreach.

kevin_se: Probably a token TTL issue + stale key on their side. Could also be hitting per-user rate limits because they started an ingest spike. Short-term: we can push a temporary quota bump for 24h and rotate the app credentials if they want. I can do the bump if CS signs off. Link to runbook: <https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/provisioning-troubleshoot>

julia_csm: Comms plan suggestion: 1) 30m "triage" call with customer within 1h, include engineering (kevin) and support (mike). 2) Share root-cause investigations and temporary mitigation (quota bump + credential rotate). 3) Follow-up email template + next steps and timeline. I'll draft email once we confirm time.

anna_cs: Proposed schedule: triage call at 16:00 PT (in 45m). I'll be host. @kevin_se please join for credential checks. @mike_support pls collect logs and enable debug level for ingest path.

mike_support: OK will attach logs to the case and enable debug for that org. Also granting temporary access to kevin: `grant_org_debug acct_4234 --expires=24h` executed.

kevin_se: Got access. I'll validate tokens and run the credential rotate steps. If rotation required, do a quick canary rotate: rotate on a single test workspace then full.

julia_csm: Draft email (short):
"Hi Lina — thanks for the patience. We're scheduling a 30m troubleshooting call today at 16:00 PT. We'll review the failed ingests, apply a temporary quota increase, and if needed rotate the integration token. We'll follow with a summary and timeline to full remediation. — Julia, Customer Success"

anna_cs: Action items mine: 1) Host call + send calendar invite (done) 2) Confirm temporary quota bump approved (kevin/mike) 3) Post-call summary and escalation to renewals if we see churn signal. I'll update INC-2026-178 after the call.

mike_support: Ack. I'll mark the case as P1 and notify sales enablement if they ask about renewal concessions.

kevin_se: Quick note — if we see KV cache hot spots during ingest, switch to the low-latency config for that org: `--inference-mode=burst` until they stabilize. I'll monitor during the call.

anna_cs: Thanks all. If we make progress on call, I'll close this thread and link the postmortem. If not, escalate to Director CS & Eng. :thumbsup:

mike_support: Thanks — standing by for the call.

anna_cs: Update (post-call): Rotated token on a canary workspace, applied 2x quota bump for 24h, customer saw successful ingest on retry. They were relieved. Next steps: 1) monitor for 48h, 2) schedule a technical follow-up next week to harden integration, 3) renewals touchpoint deferred but on watch. Updating INC-2026-178 now.
